add-column: The seller profile reply-to address is a nullable column without a default, a catalog-only change that rewrites no rows; the 1s lock_timeout bounds the wait for the brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the small seller_profiles table.
add-foreign-key: Each foreign key is declared on the new, empty invoice_sends table, so validation scans no rows; the referenced organization, invoices and user tables are held only in SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE for the catalog update, bounded by the 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: Enabling and forcing row security touches only the new, empty invoice_sends table created in the same migration; no existing relation is locked.
create-policy: The policies are created on the new, empty invoice_sends table created in the same migration; the restrictive policy only references invoices in its expression and takes no lock on it.
